paintings.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit target image 1 is an existing Rabbit Lands inventory icon atlas, exactly 5 columns by 5 rows, read left to right, top to bottom. Reference image 2 is STYLE AND BACKGROUND ONLY: the Artificer's Cape icon. Repaint the edit target as a polished hand-painted fantasy inventory atlas matching that cape: broad chunky readable shapes, matte hand-painted materials, warm restrained highlights, crisp silhouettes. Remove ALL old blue haze, cyan fog, square glow patches, harsh internal tile edges, and blue vignette backgrounds. EVERY cell must instead use one identical FLAT opaque deep almost-black teal background RGB(5,15,18), like the reference cape. Each item's entire silhouette must be contained inside its own cell with generous safe margin. Preserve EXACTLY the same 25 item identities, colors, silhouettes, and row/column positions, one item in each cell. Do not move, merge, omit, duplicate or replace any item; keep blank areas blank. No text, numbers, border, grid lines, labels, frames, scenery, cast shadows, glow, bloom or watermark. Square output, exact evenly spaced 5x5 grid spanning the square, each icon centered within its own equal square. For tools (pickaxe, hatchet, needle and thread, mortar and pestle), improve them into weighty practical hand-painted tools with chunky handles, believable metal/stone materials and clear construction, consistent with the newer equipment. Preserve all other object designs.
paintings.review: Grid order and all source identities reviewed at full resolution; chunky painted materials and no blue background haze.

paintings.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one Rabbit Lands inventory item icon for Potion of Minor Healing. Reference image 1 is DESIGN ONLY, copy the small red potion flask in the BOTTOM-RIGHT cell, row 5 column 5; disregard every other item. Reference image 2 is STYLE AND BACKGROUND ONLY, Artificer's Cape. One complete small round glass flask, bright ruby-red healing liquid, short narrow neck, warm brass/gold neck collar and simple brown cork, no emblem. Broad chunky matte hand-painted fantasy forms, restrained warm highlights, readable at 50px. Center the whole flask, keep 12% empty safe margin on ALL sides. Exact flat opaque dark teal background RGB(5,15,18), matching the cape. No haze, glow, blue fog, frame, panel, tile border, letters, text, numbers, additional items, scene or shadow.

Use case: style-transfer. Paint ONE Rabbit Lands generic training cape inventory icon. Input image 1 DESIGN ONLY: preserve the plain dark slate-blue cape in its BOTTOM-RIGHT cell (row 5 column 5). Input image 2 STYLE AND BACKGROUND ONLY: match matte cloth, broad hand-painted folds and exact dark teal flat backing, but DO NOT COPY its emblem or embroidery. One unworn cape, viewed from behind, dark slate blue matte cloth with simple narrow muted gold edging and round shoulder yoke. Absolutely plain cloth: NO stars, gears, crests, insignia, runes or other emblems. Complete cape centered with 10% empty margin; no hood, wearer, hands or mannequin. Background uniformly RGB(5,15,18). No blue haze, glow, vignette, framing or sharp internal panel edges. No text.
